lessons: The failure was transient provider capacity ('Selected model is at capacity'), not a defect in the approach. Rerun Implement at the same capability. The earlier partial edits to chupa/git.py and chupa/box.py may still be in the worktree: read them before rewriting.

Finish the whole fence in one pass: chupa/box.py, tests/test_box.py, git_common_dir in chupa/git.py with tests/test_git.py coverage, and `git rm bootstrap/suggestions.md`. Delete the file; do not edit it.

The main checkout's <state_dir>/box/ already holds the ingested bootstrap messages, so `python -m chupa.box` will print 0 new messages. That is correct, so do not 'fix' it. Tests must build their own temp repo and worktree and never touch the real state dir.

Write box files only through FileSystem.write. Raise BoxError on any file that fails Message validation, never skip it. Dedup against every message, pending or resolved. Compute seq as the highest existing seq plus 1.
Before finishing, run all four Verification commands, including the full `uv run pytest -q`, and confirm the diff touches only the five fenced paths.
